title: Fail closed when auth usage debit cannot be confirmed
description: POST /api/v1/models/30/predict is served when the auth-service usage debit returns a 5xx or the transport fails, creating unbilled usage. For billable prediction routes, invoke the downstream handler only after a confirmed 2xx debit. Preserve the structured 402 insufficient-funds response, map 5xx and transport failures to a retryable client-safe 503, fail closed for all other non-2xx debit results, preserve the free contribution-ingestion bypass, and log outcome plus opaque API-key ID, model ID, idempotency key, and request ID without secrets. Tests must cover 5xx, network error, non-402 4xx, successful 2xx, 402, and contribution routes, including route-level proof that Model 30 inference is not invoked on debit failure.
